title: Juncate
summary: JUNC'ATE, noun [Latin juncus, a rush.] 1. A cheese-cake; a kind of sweetmeat of curds and sugar. 2. Any kind of delicate food. 3. A furtive or private entertainment. [It is now written junket.]
